---
## Ingredients
- 300 g Montasio cheese
- 1 onion
- 40 g butter
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Peel the onion, dice it, and pour it into a pan with the hot butter.
2. Let it wilt over low heat with the pan covered for about 5 minutes, moistening with a few tablespoons of water.
3. Thinly slice the cheese and add it to the onion.
4. Cook, stirring with a wooden spoon always in the same direction.
5. When the cake begins to harden, turn it with the help of a lid and let it brown on the other side as well, without stirring.
